name: vscode-workbench-closer
description: Automatically closes selected VS Code workbench parts after editor activity.
author: statiolake

vscode-workbench-closer.selectionChangeT.description: Number of editor selection changes required within a workbench part's activity window to start its closing delay.

vscode-workbench-closer.primarySidebar.e.description: Automatically close the primary sidebar after enough editor selection changes.

vscode-workbench-closer.primarySidebar.s.description: Activity window and closing delay in milliseconds for the primary sidebar. After the threshold is reached, it closes on the first selection change after this time from the first qualifying change.

vscode-workbench-closer.secondarySidebar.description: Automatically close the secondary sidebar after enough editor selection changes.
Activity window and closing delay in milliseconds for the secondary sidebar. After the threshold is reached, it closes on the first selection change after this time from the first qualifying change.

vscode-workbench-closer.panel.enabled.description: Automatically close the bottom panel after enough editor selection changes.

vscode-workbench-closer.panel.selectionC.description: Activity window and closing delay in milliseconds for the bottom panel. After the threshold is reached, it closes on the first selection change after this time from the first qualifying change.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
scripts.package: npm run compile && npm run lint && vsce package
scripts.publish: npm run compile && npm run lint && vsce publish
scripts.publish:vsce: npm run compile && npm run lint && vsce publish
scripts.publish:ovsx: npm run compile && npm run lint && ovsx publish
